title: Brent H. Nielson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a youth, Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Marcia Ann Bradford 1978; six children
Bachelor of Arts in English, BYU 1978; Juris Doctor, University of Utah, 1981
Attorney in private practice in Twin Falls, Idaho
Bishop, High Councilor, SP's Counselor, Stake President, and Area Seventy.
First Quorum of the Seventy 2009 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
